# Unity Architecture

> AGENTS.md rule set for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Rider AI Assistant, Codex) on Unity 6 projects. Strict MVC for uGUI with stable rule IDs and RFC 2119 keywords, optional Roslyn analyzers (UA0001-UA0016, `install.sh --analyzers`), a scope question before each new feature (code only, with prefabs, with tests), and a verify loop (scripts/verify.sh plus a Claude Code Stop hook) that stops an agent from finishing with a broken build. A project profile, written once from the manifest, resolves each package-dependent rule to one branch, so agents never read the rules of packages a project lacks. Works with Unity MCP servers and the Unity CLI. Install as a git submodule at `.ai/`, then run `bash .ai/templates/scripts/install.sh` from the project root; `update.sh` updates it later. MIT licensed, pre-release, single author, no other users yet.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/README.md): installation, templates, verify loop, FAQ
- [Installation](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): step by step from a new Unity project: Git, submodule, install.sh, MCP for Unity setup, Claude Code
- [Usage](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): Claude Code prompts with the Editor open or closed, prefab specs, the Stop hook's messages
- [Prefabs](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/architecture/PREFABS.md): prefab rules, recipes, JSON specs and the prefab validator
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/AGENTS.md): entry point, architecture invariants, document routing
- [Agent workflow](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/architecture/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md): task classification, plan, checklist, Definition of Done
- [Editor tools](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/architecture/EDITOR_TOOLS.md): verification with Unity MCP, the Unity CLI or verify.sh
- [MVC](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/architecture/MVC.md): Models, Views, Controllers, where a Model lives
- [Optional packages](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/architecture/OPTIONAL_PACKAGES.md): the project profile (scripts/ai-profile.sh) and the forks that send an agent to one branch per package
- [Analyzers](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-architecture/blob/main/analyzers/README.md): Roslyn rules and installation
